sentences: I press the button with the up arrow and wait for the doors to open.
I step inside and check the panel to see which floor buttons are already lit.
The doors close slowly, and I watch the floor numbers change above the panel.
I stand near the back corner and keep my hands at my sides during the ride.
I press the button for the fourth floor and the light around it turns on.
I read the inspection certificate posted inside the elevator to check the date.
I hold the door open button while another person walks in with a cart.
The chime sounds, and I look at the indicator to see which floor we have reached.
I count the number of people inside and compare it to the maximum capacity sign.
I press the alarm button once to test it, then step back and wait.
The elevator stops, and I wait for the doors to open before stepping out.
I notice the handrail along the wall and place my hand on it.
I use my key card to access the restricted floor and press the button for the basement.
I check the floor directory on the wall before entering the elevator to find the office number.
The doors open, and I step aside to let the passengers exit first.
I press the close door button and watch the gap between the doors narrow.
I look at the small mirror on the ceiling and adjust my collar before the doors open.
I listen to the motor hum as the elevator moves between floors.
I notice the emergency phone on the side panel and read the instructions printed above it.
I step out onto the floor and check the sign to confirm the room numbers on this level.
